title: Resource-rational and bounded-rational accounts
summary: Rationality under limited computation: the algorithmic level and resource rationality; explaining deviations from Bayesian inference by the cost of inference; rational process models and the sampling hypothesis.

preparation.description: Read chapter 1 of Gershman's draft textbook, Reverse engineering the brain, including its section on resource rationality.
Read chapter 4, The Bayesian brain, on explaining deviations from Bayesian inference.
Read the Probabilistic Models of Cognition chapter on rational process models (reference-only; read on the book's site).
